questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that a four-way intersection is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells drivers to prepare for a stop sign ahead. You should slow down and be ready to come to a complete stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts drivers that lanes are shifting ahead. You should be ready to follow the new lane direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
You are approaching a T intersection.
The road that you are on intersects with a divided highway.
You are on an overpass above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road that you are on intersects with a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that your road is crossing a divided highway. A divided highway has two separate one-way roads split by a median or barrier.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Highway changes ahead and to the right.
Hiking trails ahead and to the right.
Hotel ahead and to the right.
Hospital ahead and to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hospital ahead and to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that a hospital with emergency services is located to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign shows a traffic rule that drivers must obey. It means you cannot park your vehicle in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep downhill section of road is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign shows a traffic rule that drivers must obey. It directs you to keep to the right side to avoid a hazard ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a traffic signal is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An intersection is ahead where another road crosses this one.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A flagger is ahead controlling traffic in a construction area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Driving with your headlights out of alignment because one side of your car is higher than the other.
Damaging a tire from drifting onto the shoulder.
Hydroplaning, if the shoulder has water on it.
Losing control of the vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: Losing control of the vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: The shoulder ahead is lower than the road. If your wheel drops onto the low shoulder, do not slam on the brakes or turn sharply. This can cause you to lose control of your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that a curve in the road is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This one-way sign shows that you can only travel in the direction the arrow points.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you to watch for pedestrians crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The exact speed at which you must travel to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
The maximum safe driving speed under all road conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the fastest legal speed for that road. You may need to drive slower if conditions are not ideal, like in rain or snow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: The road ahead has a series of turns and curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Railroad tracks cross the road at a steep slope. Low vehicles may drag or get stuck on the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A school crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must bear either right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must bear either right or left.
questions.explanation: A Y intersection is ahead. You must choose to go either right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits U-turns. Do not make a U-turn at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always stop, whether there’s a stop sign or not.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always sound your horn when you see children.
Be ready to help children crossing the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: You must always yield to pedestrians in or entering a crosswalk. Watch for pedestrians at intersections and when turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means it is not safe to enter the road or driveway from your direction. Turn around and find a different route.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
Slow down without coming to a complete stop.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
questions.explanation: Any eight-sided sign is a stop sign. Come to a complete stop and check for pedestrians and cross traffic. Wait for the intersection to clear before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Left turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign tells you a playground is nearby, so watch for children near the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars in right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: A merge is ahead. Two lanes of traffic moving in the same direction will become one lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign warns that a winding road is ahead. Slow down and be prepared for curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs enforce traffic rules that drivers must obey. This sign indicates there are multiple lanes for left turns. Drivers in the far left lane must turn left.
